guidance.title: Preventive Guidance
guidance.exerciseLow: Maintain regular low-impact exercise: walking, swimming, cycling 30 min/day.
guidance.exerciseModerate: Gentle strengthening exercises for quadriceps. Water aerobics recommended. Avoid high-impact sports.
guidance.exerciseHigh: Physiotherapy-guided exercises. Non-weight-bearing activities (swimming). Refer to physiotherapist.
guidance.nutritionLow: Maintain a healthy weight. Eat anti-inflammatory foods: turmeric, ginger, leafy greens, omega-3.
guidance.nutritionModerate: Weight management is critical. Reduce processed foods. Calcium + Vitamin D supplementation.
guidance.nutritionHigh: Clinical dietary guidance recommended. Anti-inflammatory diet. Weight loss program if BMI > 25.
guidance.lifestyleLow: Wear supportive footwear. Avoid prolonged sitting or standing. Do regular stretching.
guidance.lifestyleModerate: Use supportive footwear/knee brace if needed. Avoid climbing stairs when possible. Monitor progression.
guidance.lifestyleHigh: Assistive devices (walking stick). Home safety modifications. Clinical review within 4 weeks.
